milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task where the player must navigate to and visually identify the brown wool pillar. The brown wool structure is a 2x2x3 pillar at spawn-relative (2,0,2) to (3,2,3). Target is set to the center at (3,1,3). max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually approached the structure (not just glancing from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task where the player must navigate further from spawn to the pink concrete structure. The pink concrete is a 3x3x3 block at spawn-relative (6,0,2) to (8,2,4). Target is set to the center at (7,1,3). max_distance=5 requires the player to walk from the brown wool area to the pink concrete area, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actively looking at the pink blocks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting pink_stained_glass results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 8 pink dye and 8 glass, and must use the crafting table at (9,0,3) to craft pink_stained_glass (recipe: 8 glass + 1 pink dye = 8 pink_stained_glass). Checking for min_count=1 confirms the craft was completed. The player does NOT start with any pink_stained_glass, so any presence confirms success.
